package sandbox

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/llm/safecall"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/pkg/types"
)

// 声明只出现在 if 块里的追加：可能不执行，不得算作已声明（否则条件分支会让规则永远绿灯）。
func selftestSpreadConditional(ctx context.Context, p protocol.Provider, deep bool) {
	opts := []types.InferOption{types.WithMaxTokens(8)}
	if deep {
		opts = append(opts, types.WithPurpose("selftest"), types.WithThinkingMode(types.ThinkingHigh))
	}
	_, _ = safecall.Infer(ctx, p, nil, opts...)
}
